programme.title: Bad Teacher
programme.desc: (2011) Naughty kids are one thing but a naughty teacher? Can titular educator Cameron Diaz win a big-bucks teaching competition... and buy surgical enhancements to seduce Justin Timberlake?

programme.title: Late Night with the Devil
programme.desc: (2023) Unsettling found-footage horror with David Dastmalchian. A has-been host tries to save his 70s talk show using a demonically possessed 13-year-old girl. Really, what could go wrong?

programme.title: It Came from Outer Space
programme.desc: (1953) Richard Carlson stars as an astronomer who sees an alien craft land. But nobody believes him - until the cloning starts in Jack Arnold's science-fiction classic.

programme.title: Fantastic Voyage
programme.desc: (1966) Classic sci-fi adventure. Raquel Welch and Donald Pleasence are among the crew of a miniaturised submarine that's injected into an injured diplomat's body in a bid to save his life.

programme.title: The Caine Mutiny
programme.desc: (1954) Oscar-nominated Humphrey Bogart, in one of his finest roles, stars in Edward Dmytryk's gripping drama as Captain Philip Queeg, in charge of a US Navy minesweeper during the war.

programme.title: The Frogmen
programme.desc: (1951) Second World War thriller. Richard Widmark, Dana Andrews and Robert Wagner star as divers with a special underwater demolition team taking the war to the Japanese in the Pacific.

programme.title: Jerry & Marge Go Large
programme.desc: (2022) Fact-based comedy starring Bryan Cranston and Annette Bening as a retired couple who find a way to exploit a lottery loophole. But then some rich kids try to muscle in...

programme.title: LA Confidential
programme.desc: (1997) Curtis Hanson's thriller of cops and corruption set in 1950s LA - with Kevin Spacey, Guy Pearce, Russell Crowe and Kim Basinger. Based on James Ellroy's detective novel.

programme.title: Once Upon a Time in Hollywood
programme.desc: (2019) Quentin Tarantino's darkly comic drama set in 60s LA, starring Leonardo DiCaprio, Brad Pitt and Margot Robbie. A failing actor's world collides with the Manson Family.

programme.desc: Jamie Oliver cooks a super-speedy smoked salmon pasta, a loaded beef burger with sweet red peppers, pickles and mustard, and toffee apple buns. S1, Ep7

programme.title: Jamie's One Pan Wonders
programme.desc: Jamie cooks an aubergine burger, a sesame-seared salmon supper, and a chickpea and squash casserole that can be turned into a host of tasty dishes. S1, Ep8

programme.title: Jamie's Quick And Easy Food
programme.desc: Scallops, Steak, Flat Breads. Chef Jamie Oliver shows off his speedy cooking by preparing seared scallops. Plus, he serves up delicious rib-eye steak and almond puff. S1, Ep1

programme.title: Jamie's Quick And Easy Food
programme.desc: Tuna, Meatballs, Cookies. Jamie demonstrates fast and tasty cooking by searing a mouth-watering sesame tuna steak. Then, he makes messy meatball buns and chocolate rye cookies. S1, Ep2

programme.title: Jamie's Quick And Easy Food
programme.desc: Fishcakes, Linguine, Lamb Chops. Jamie Oliver cooks up quick Asian fishcakes with a sweet and spicy glaze. Then, he serves up lemon and courgette linguine and sticky lamb chops. S1, Ep3

programme.title: Jamie's Quick And Easy Food
programme.desc: Lamb, Spaghetti, Fish, Cookies. Jamie cooks tender lamb shoulder with an easy cheat for maximum flavour. Plus, he prepares his speedy veggie spaghetti and apple crumble cookies. S1, Ep4

programme.title: Jamie's Quick And Easy Food
programme.desc: Beef, Crispy Squid, Polenta Cake. Jamie prepares high-speed Ginger Shakin' Beef with pak choi. Then, he makes crispy squid and smashed avocado, plus almond, orange and polenta cake. S1, Ep5

programme.title: Jamie's Quick And Easy Food
programme.desc: Pork Burger, Prawns, Gnocchi, Cheesecake. Jamie Oliver cooks pork burger, taking fast food to the next level! Later, he serves up sticky mango prawns and frozen banoffee cheesecake. S1, Ep6

programme.title: Jamie's Quick And Easy Food
programme.desc: Chicken, Salad, Pasta & Shortbread. Jamie starts by cooking up his tasty tikka chicken. Next, he prepares a vibrant carrot and grain salad, and chocolate orange shortbread. S1, Ep7

programme.title: Jamie's Quick And Easy Food
programme.desc: Sausage Carbonara & One-Pot Thai Chicken. Jamie makes super-fast sausage carbonara with a peppery punch! Then he serves up a spicy one-pot Thai red chicken soup and steamed pudding. S1, Ep8

programme.title: James Martin's: Island To Highlands
programme.desc: Dorset. James's trip along the south coast continues in Dorset with pal and award-winning chef, Paul Ainsworth. They enjoy a gorgeous beachside barbeque. S1, Ep6

programme.title: James Martin's: Island To Highlands
programme.desc: Oxford. In Oxford, James is joined by top chef Monica Galetti, who discovers the delights of an organic local distiller. Plus, James visits Raymond Blanc. S1, Ep7

programme.title: James Martin's: Island To Highlands
programme.desc: South Wales. James is in South Wales, accompanied by his mate, top chef Stephen Terry. They discover award-winning Welsh wine and organic Welsh chocolate. S1, Ep8

programme.title: James Martin's: Island To Highlands
programme.desc: Mid Wales. James explores Mid Wales, joined by Michelin-starred chef Gareth Ward. The trip includes Welsh Mountain cider tasting and a decadent Welsh rarebit. S1, Ep9

programme.title: James Martin's: Island To Highlands
programme.desc: The Peak District. James's trip continues in the stunning scenery of the Peak District. He's joined by cooking legend, Tessa Bramley, and cooks up a tasty beef stew. S1, Ep10

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: South & South Of The Border. Guy Fieri seeks out South flavours! He visits an old ice cream shop serving seafood in Tybee Island and then a creative taco spot in Boise. S37, Ep7

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: Sloppy, Saucy & Stuffed. Guy Fieri heads to a Los Angeles spot dishing out El Salvadorian with a twist. Then, he visits an Oregon food cart that serves up authentic Indian. S37, Ep8

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: Mom And Dad. Guy Fieri hangs out at some mom-and-pop spots. In Denver, Colorado, he tastes Caribbean-soul favourites and in Logan, Utah, specialities from India are on the menu. S31, Ep8

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: Wrapped, Pied And Fried. Guy Fieri has it wrapped, pied and fried with craveable carnitas in Mobile, Alabama, elevated pizza in Cody, Wyoming, and brisket in Omaha, Nebraska. S38, Ep8

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: From Beef To Bao. Guy Fieri tastes a funky peanut butter burger at a joint in Logan, Utah. Plus, he tucks into bomb bao buns served out of a tiny trailer in Juneau, Alaska. S31, Ep10

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: Hometown Inspiration. Guy Fieri heads to Portland, Oregon, to visit a spot putting a vegan spin on Israeli flavours. Plus, Louisiana specialities are on the menu in Logan, Utah. S31, Ep11

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: East-West Flavorfest. Guy is after a taste of Asian and American. He tries a funky joint serving knockout dumpling, and in Ocean City he tries cheeseburger and chicken vodka pies. S23, Ep13

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: Flavortown International. In Portland, Guy visits a funky spot that's cooking real-deal Mexican tortas. And, he tastes samosas and chicken kabobs in Warr Acres, Oklahoma. S31, Ep13

programme.title: Man V. Food
programme.desc: Hartford, Connecticut. Adam Richman is off to Hartford, Connecticut for some humongous hot dogs, steamed cheeseburgers, and a ten-pound super-stuffed pizza challenge. S2, Ep20

programme.title: Man V. Food
programme.desc: San Diego. Adam Richman heads to San Diego, California, for a massive surf-and-turf burrito, tender tri-tip barbecue and a legendary Ironman food challenge. S2, Ep21

programme.title: Michel Roux's Provence Masterclass
programme.desc: Sunday Lunch. Michel takes Sunday lunch to the next level. He serves fish quenelles, chicken cooked in salt crust pastry and red wine poached pears with galette serpentine. S1, Ep1

programme.title: Michel Roux's Provence Masterclass
programme.desc: Relaxed Supper. Michel hosts a relaxed supper for friends. He prepares snails with hazelnuts, bourride sétoise and chocolate mousse with pineapple and rum. S1, Ep2

programme.title: Michel Roux's Provence Masterclass
programme.desc: Michel serves up a feast that's made to share. He prepares a smoked fish platter, a rich beef cheek bourguignon and a lattice-topped salted caramel and walnut tart. S1, Ep3

programme.title: Michel Roux's Provence Masterclass
programme.desc: Brunch. Michel prepares his delicious take on brunch. He serves up cheese soufflés, chicken and wild mushroom pithivier and an elegant sweet wine jelly. S1, Ep4

programme.title: Michel Roux's Provence Masterclass
programme.desc: Michel cooks a meal to celebrate the best of autumn. Curried mussel millefeuille, a rich venison daube and a trio of differently flavoured choux buns are on the menu. S1, Ep5

programme.title: The Hairy Bikers Mediterranean Adventure
programme.desc: Mainland Italy. The Hairy Bikers start their Mediterranean tour in the south of Italy. They try delicious local specialities like spicy n'duja sausage. S1, Ep1

programme.title: The Hairy Bikers Mediterranean Adventure
programme.desc: Sardinia. The bikers begin the Sardinian part of their adventure in the small town of Cagliari, where the locals are in high spirits for the feast of St Efisio. S1, Ep2

programme.title: The Hairy Bikers Mediterranean Adventure
programme.desc: Corsica. The bikers begin in the south of Corsica. They taste sausage figatelli, veal and olive stew, and stuffed mussels with courgette gratin. S1, Ep3

programme.title: The Hairy Bikers Mediterranean Adventure
programme.desc: Mainland France. The bikers begin in Marseille, one of the largest ports in the Mediterranean. There, they sample bourride, a delicious fish stew. S1, Ep4

programme.title: The Hairy Bikers Mediterranean Adventure
programme.desc: Balearics. The bikers visit Minorca and Majorca to devour tasty local produce. They try cuttlefish stew and ensaimadas with almond filling. S1, Ep5

programme.title: The Hairy Bikers Mediterranean Adventure
programme.desc: Mainland Spain. In Valencia, the bikers explore the Moorish influence on the cuisine of Spain before heading to Torremolinos to try some of the country's best tapas. S1, Ep6

programme.title: James Martin's: Island To Highlands
programme.desc: Yorkshire Dales. James returns home to his native Yorkshire. He's joined by friend and award-winning chef, Brian Turner as he tries some clay pigeon shooting. S1, Ep11

programme.title: James Martin's: Island To Highlands
programme.desc: The Lake District. James's journey brings him to Cumbria. He's joined by top Michelin-starred chef, Clare Smyth, for a leg that includes a trip out on Lake Windermere. S1, Ep12

programme.title: James Martin's: Island To Highlands
programme.desc: Northumberland. James samples the delights of Northumberland, joined by Michelin-starred chef Kenny Atkinson. They learn how mead is made on Holy Island. S1, Ep13

programme.title: James Martin's: Island To Highlands
programme.desc: Isle of Man. James visits the Isle of Man during its famous TT warm-up week. He's joined by Michelin-starred chef and fellow petrolhead, Lisa Goodwin-Allen. S1, Ep14

programme.title: James Martin's: Island To Highlands
programme.desc: The Royal Scotsman. James's Scottish adventure starts in Edinburgh aboard the luxurious Royal Scotsman. Top chef Nick Nairn joins him to eat in its stunning dining room. S1, Ep17

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: Burger, Bird And Meaty Italian. Guy Fieri dives into a meaty smorgasbord! There's a skyscraper burger in Nashville and in Florida, a rockin' chef cooks up real deal gnocchi. S36, Ep1

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: Stuffed, Smoked And Wrapped. Guy Fieri checks out a funky Nashville eatery. In Florida, two beach spots smoke up alligator ribs and serve Venezuelan stuffed specialties. S36, Ep2

programme.title: Red Eye
programme.desc: Eighteen months after Russia is blamed for shooting down a new cargo plane over the Atlantic, DS Hana Li is summoned to investigate the murder of an American diplomatic courier at Heathrow. The investigation leads her to London's US Embassy where new American Ambassador Ronald Tillman is hosting a party. Realising the killer has infiltrated the building, Hana and US Embassy security chief Clay Brody hunt them down. Meanwhile, a Russian threat is received onboard a UK Government jet. Thriller, starring Jing Lusi, Martin Compston and Lesley Sharp

programme.title: Love Your New Year's Day with Alan Titchmarsh
programme.desc: Bonnie Langford and Gregor Fisher join Alan for a New Year's Day chat. Survivalist Ray Mears gives Joe Sugg a masterclass in bush craft, the top five dogs from 2025 are featured, and there are suggestions for brunch-time tipples and treats to help with those January 1st hangovers

programme.title: Fletchers' Family Farm at Christmas
programme.desc: In the wake of the fire that left their home uninhabitable, the Fletchers are determined to end the year on a brighter note and head to Austria on a snowy Alpine adventure. From the world-famous ski slopes of Hintertux, to the majestic forests of Soll, they journey into the heart of the Austrian Alps, discovering a farming culture rich in tradition. Staying with generational farmers Josef and Martina Achrainer and their extended family, the Fletchers experience true Alpine hospitality and learn why the mesmerising sound of cow bells are a traditional part of livestock handling, and even how to round up chickens using a chant

programme.title: Ainsley's Festive Flavours
programme.desc: Ainsley Harriott throws open the kitchen doors and welcomes friends old and new for a Christmas feast. Actress and comedian Donna Preston pops in for a slice of mouth-watering tamarind, allspice and ginger glazed ham, with a juicy side of pineapple and rum relish, while actor Christopher Biggins joins for a taste of Ainsley's showstopping snow dome dessert, packed with festive flavours. Chef Phil Vickery lends a hand and offers up a party-friendly taste of the sea with his squid, prawn almond patties, and wine expert Jilly Goolden selects drinks for every occasion. Plus, music from classical star Alexis Ffrench

programme.title: James Martin's Great British Adventure
programme.desc: The chef explores the Isle of Wight with fellow culinary expert Lenny Carr-Roberts. James sets up at The Hut Café, Colwell to cook a dish of prawns with tomatoes, mangalitza chorizo and pancetta

programme.title: James Martin's Saturday Morning at Christmas
programme.desc: James celebrates Christmas at his home in the Hampshire countryside by serving up a feast of festive food for Strictly Come Dancing star Shirley Ballas.

programme.title: Prue Leith's Cotswold Kitchen
programme.desc: The Great British Bake Off judge returns to share more recipes, tips and handy culinary hacks . She is joined for the opening edition by actress Angela Griffin, who is treated to a Cambodian dish of fish and prawn amok. Prue also makes meat and vegetarian lasagnes, while her husband John heads off to a local alpaca farm where he learns how they are taken care of and finds out what their wool is used for

programme.desc: James cooks for Grantchester stars Rishi Nair and Kacey Ainsworth and wildlife filmmaker Gordon Buchanan, and there are recipes from chefs Cyrus Todiwala and Ronnie Murray

programme.title: Ainsley's Taste of the Bahamas
programme.desc: Chef Ainsley Harriott explores the vibrant flavours, local producers, markets and unique dishes of the island nation located in the Atlantic Ocean. He kicks off his island adventures with the comfort foods at the heart of Bahamian cooking, from 'chicken in da bag' at Bamboo Shack to learning to put his peas before his rice with chef Tevin Kemp. Then he wraps things up in his beachside kitchen with prawn and coconut fritters served with a pickled coconut slaw

programme.title: Simply Raymond Blanc
programme.desc: The chef shares his love of new produce from the gardens and explains why seasonality is important and why everyone should embrace it. From his Oxfordshire kitchen, he cooks pan-fried salmon with spinach and chive butter sauce, and rustles up a fricassee of wild mushrooms. Long-time friend Jean-Christophe Novelli pays a visit and bakes him an indulgent tarte tatin, and baked apple with caramel

programme.title: STV Racing: Live from Sandown
programme.desc: Ed Chamberlin presents coverage of a meeting headlined by the Unibet Veterans' Chase from Sandown Park, plus racing from Wincanton. With analysis from Tom Scudamore, reports by Oli Bell and Alice Plunkett, and commentary from Richard Hoiles

programme.title: ITV News and Weather
programme.desc: Round-up of the latest headlines

programme.title: Ant and Dec's Limitless Win Christmas Special
programme.desc: Ant and Dec spread the Christmas joy by surprising two audience members with the chance to take on the money-making ladder - but for the first time, they will be playing alongside their own celebrity team-mates. Mother-of-two Brooke, who has recently had cancer and set up a support group for women in her local area, is joined by Amanda Holden to make as much money as she can. Army veteran Nigel, who has launched a coffee company to support the mental health of other ex-servicemen and women, will be accompanied by football star Jamie Redknapp. Will these famous faces help the players to a festive fortune?

programme.title: Celebrity Catchphrase
programme.desc: Stephen Mulhern hosts another charity edition of the game show, with Natalie Cassidy, Sam Aston and Lou Sanders trying to say what they see as they guess well-known phrases for the chance to win a £50,000 jackpot for their chosen good causes

programme.title: The Masked Singer
programme.desc: Joel Dommett is back with the singing contest in which celebrity panellists Jonathan Ross, Davina McCall, Mo Gilligan and Maya Jama must guess the identities of the famous faces performing behind elaborate costumes. The first six masked singers battling it out are Red Panda, Moth, Disc Jockey, Sloth, Gargoyle and Can of Worms, while Goldfish fronts the Masked Band

programme.title: Wheel of Fortune
programme.desc: Graham Norton hosts the game show as executive assistant Yemi, funeral celebrant Richard and support worker Aimee compete to solve word puzzles to get the chance to spin the wheel and win big money prizes, with a potential jackpot of £50,000

programme.title: The 1% Club
programme.desc: Quiz game show hosted by Lee Mack in which the questions have nothing to do with remembering facts, but are all about logic and common sense. A hundred contestants begin every show, but who will make it to the end and answer a question only one per cent of the country can get right - and win up to £100,000?

programme.title: The Hunting Wives
programme.desc: Margo attempts to win back Sophie with a surprise, while Jill's concern about her son's relationship with Abby intensifies, as does Callie's jealousy. The police make a chilling discovery in the case of the unidentified dead woman

programme.desc: Freddie Flintoff is joined by three pairs of contestants each made up of a keen darts player (the 'thrower') and their partner (the 'knower'). The teams compete against each other, combining their skills at throwing darts at different game boards while answering questions correctly for points and prizes under the watchful eye of official scorer Richard Ashdown. Freddie is also joined by former world champion Michael van Gerwen, as they combine to complete a charity challenge

programme.desc: Birmingham City v Coventry City (Kick-off 12.00pm). Hugh Woozencroft presents coverage of the Championship match between the Midlands rivals from St Andrew's @ Knighthead Park.
